keyPhrases.text: perfect man to bring 'Cyrano' into the 21st century
Mr. Kline knows what he's doing
lands every joke and metaphor in style
may not make a case for...immortal work of high art

reasoning: Strong positive review with enthusiastic praise for the production, direction, and performances. Uses positive metaphors ('double shot of silvery hokum,' 'goes down so easily') and praises the director as 'perfect' for the material. Minor reservation about it not being 'high art' but frames this positively as effective entertainment. Clear recommendation through sustained praise.
